# Cost and time model results (generated by cost_model.py)

FX: 1 EUR = 1.1188 USD (ECB 2026-10-13). VAT 21% shown separately. OpenRouter fee 5.5% included in AI totals. All token figures are ASSUMPTIONS.

## 1. AI cost of one complete 100-rule x 10-layer pass (1,000 cells)

| Scenario | Primary / challenger | Input MTok | Output MTok | AI USD (pre-fee) | Search USD | DeepL € (unverified) | **€ ex VAT** | € inc 21% VAT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| low | haiku-5.5 / gemini-3.5-flash-lite | 37.6 | 5.7 | 5 | 15 | 0 | **18** | 22 |
| base | sonnet-5.5 / gemini-3.1-pro | 73.6 | 11.1 | 263 | 25 | 60 | **330** | 400 |
| high | opus-5.5 / gpt-6-astra | 174.4 | 26.4 | 1,643 | 50 | 60 | **1,654** | 2,002 |

Formula per stage: units × tokens × multiplier × retry ÷ 10⁶ × price per MTok × batch factor. Units = 1,000 cells for cell stages, 100 rules for rule stages. Low scenario assumes the 50% batch discount.

Compare: the proposal's €590 per run (range €170–€2,000) is a HYPOTHESIS; this model's spread is wider because model choice alone moves cost by two orders of magnitude.
